description: Make a production-ready static map and return its URL plus a rendered preview. The map is a URL: the returned svg_url renders the same image forever, embeds in an tag with no JavaScript, and is the handle the other maproll tools accept. Use it for choropleths (numeric values per region), flat colour paints, qualitative category maps, and plain highlight maps. Region ids are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 at the "world" scope ("US", "DE", "BR") and ISO 3166-2 inside a country scope ("RO-B", "RO-CJ"). Numeric values and text categories cannot appear in the same map — pick one. Do not use it for interactive or zoomable maps, driving directions, or street-level detail; maproll renders static statistical maps, not a slippy map.

attribution.description: OpenStreetMap credit. On by default and should stay on.

bbox.description: Crop to "minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat"; the projection refits to the rectangle.

breaks.description: Bin upper bounds. Required when classification is custom.

classification.description: How numeric values are binned. Ignored for diverging and categorical scales.

colorScale.description: Sequential for magnitudes, diverging for values around a midpoint, categorical for buckets.

extra.description: Escape hatch for documented parameters without a field here (patterns, annotations, proportional, labelMinArea, ...). Passed through verbatim.

height.description: Pixel height. Defaults to the projection's aspect ratio.

highlight.description: Region ids to highlight with no data behind them. Use instead of `values` when the point is which regions, not how much.

labels.description: "ISO" labels every region above the size threshold; an array labels only those ids.

legend.description: Show the legend. Defaults true; set false for flat colour paints, which have no scale to show.

legendNoData.description: Label for an extra legend swatch, in the map's land colour, covering the regions with no value — so a reader can tell the lowest band from absent data. Pass the label itself, and make it say what blank means on THIS map: "No data" when the regions are simply missing from the dataset, "None recorded" when blank is a real zero (a banana-production map). Omit it for no swatch.

projection.description: Map projection. Each scope has a sensible default; override only with a reason.

scope.description: Geography to draw. "world", a group ("EU", "NATO", "G20", "ASEAN", "AFRICA"), or a country code for its subnational regions ("RO"). Read maproll://catalog/scopes for the full list.

values.description: Per-region data. Give `value` for a choropleth, `color` to paint a region flat, or `category` for qualitative buckets.

category.description: Qualitative bucket ("NATO", "BRICS"). Selects a categorical scale and names the bucket in the legend. Cannot be combined with numeric values.

color.description: Explicit fill as a 6-digit hex ("#ff0000"). With `value`, overrides the scale for this region. Without one, paints the region flat.

id.description: Region id. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 for the world scope ("US", "DE"); ISO 3166-2 for subnational scopes ("RO-B", "RO-CJ").

value.description: Numeric value driving the choropleth colour.

name: create_map

svg_url.description: Embeddable SVG. This is also the handle other tools take.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems, e.g. region ids the renderer did not recognise.

title: Create a map
